topics.title: 1. HTML — Tags, Attributes, Tables, Lists, Forms
topics.theory:
- **HTML** = HyperText Markup Language; **derived from SGML**; builds **static pages**; elements are the building blocks; tags are element names in **angle brackets `< >`**; **attributes are always in the START (opening) tag**. HTML5 became a W3C Recommendation in **2014**. Source is plain ASCII-compatible text. **6 heading levels** `

`–`

`. - **Common tags:** `
` line break · `
` horizontal rule (size, width, align, noshade) · `` image (`src` = URL) · `` link · `

`, ``, ``, **`` = emphasised (renders italic)**, ``, `` abbreviation · `

    ` ordered list, `
      ` unordered, `
    • ` item, `
      ` definition · `` container for page-info/metadata tags (title, meta, link, style, **`` = default URL/target for links**) · `` content · `` goes **inside head**. - **Tables:** `<table>`, **`<tr>` row**, **`<td>` data cell**, `<th>` header cell, **`colspan`** (span columns), `rowspan` (span rows), `<colgroup>/<col span=>`. - **Forms:** `<form>` (a page can have **any number of forms**), `<input type=text|password|checkbox|radio|submit|button|…>` ("source" is not a type), `<select>` with `<option>`, `<textarea>`. - **Comments:** `<!-- comment -->`. **Legacy body attrs:** LINK (unvisited), **VLINK (visited)**, ALINK (active), BGCOLOR, TEXT. Frames: `<FRAMESET COLS="80,*">` (`*` = remaining space). Image maps use `<map>` + `<area>`. - **List-style** shorthand covers list-style-type, -position, -image. **Colour in HTML:** names, hex `#000000`, `rgb(0,0,0)` = black, `hsl(h,s%,l%)` (red 0°, green 120°, blue 240°). Style attribute adds CSS inline.

qs.stem: Which of the following HTML tag is used to puts a line break in the text?
qs.sol:
The HTML
tag inserts a line break in text.

qs.stem: Which of the following is used to create static web pages?
qs.sol:
HTML defines the structure and content of a static web page.

The other choices involve asynchronous scripting or server-side page generation.

HTML uses a container element to define the list type. The ol element creates the ordered-list container, and li elements supply its individual entries. The browser then presents those entries with an ordered marker sequence.

qs.stem: Which of the following HTML tags is used to embed an image in an HTML page?
qs.sol: To embed an image in an HTML page, you must use the tag. This is the standard element defined in HTML5 for displaying images within a document structure.

qs.stem: Which of the following elements is used to define rows of a table?
qs.sol:
The HTML tr element defines a table row; th and td define cells inside a row.

TR defines a table row.

qs.stem: Which HTML attribute is used to define the URL of the image?
qs.sol: The src attribute of an HTML img element specifies the image URL.

qs.stem: How many different levels of heading does HTML support?
qs.sol:
The levels represent the importance and structural hierarchy of the content on a webpage:

<h1> : The most important heading. It is typically used for the main title of a page. Search engines and screen readers rely on this to understand the primary topic.

<h2>  through <h6> : These are used for sub-sections. As the number increases, the visual size of the text typically decreases, and the "importance" level drops.

qs.stem: Which of the following are the building blocks of HTML?
qs.sol:
HTML elements are the building blocks of an HTML document.

They define the structure and content of a web page.

qs.stem: HTML lets us use only ______ characters.
qs.sol:
The official paper keys ASCII. Historically HTML source was described using ASCII-compatible characters, although modern HTML supports Unicode.

The official paper keys ASCII for this historical wording.

qs.stem: HTML tags are element names surrounded by ______.
qs.sol:
An HTML tag encloses an element name between < and >. Those symbols are angle brackets, as in

or

.

qs.stem: HTML links are defined with the ____ tag.
qs.sol: HTML links are defined using the anchor tag <a>. This element requires an href attribute to specify the destination URL for the hyperlink connection.

qs.stem: How many forms can we have on a webpage at the maximum?
qs.sol: HTML standards do not impose a specific numerical cap on the number of form elements within a single document. While practical performance constraints might exist in browsers, the specification allows for multiple forms without restriction.

qs.stem: When was HTML 5 released?
qs.sol:
HTML5 became a W3C Recommendation in 2014, the release date used by the official key.

HTML5 reached W3C Recommendation status in 2014.

qs.stem: Which of the following HTML element is used to define table data/cell?
qs.sol: The correct HTML element for defining table data cells is <td>. While <table> creates the container and <tr> defines rows, <th> is specifically for header cells. Therefore, option 1 accurately identifies the standard data cell tag.

qs.stem: HTML attributes are always specified in the ______ tag(s).
qs.sol: HTML attributes are written inside an element’s opening or start tag, alongside the tag name. Closing tags do not carry them.

qs.stem: Which of the following can be used to display black color in HTML?
qs.sol: In HTML and CSS, the RGB color model defines black as having zero intensity for all three primary colors. Therefore, the value rgb(0, 0, 0) represents pure black.

qs.stem: Which of the following form is correct to show a ‘comments’ in the HTML language?
qs.sol: The correct HTML comment syntax begins with `<!--` and ends with `-->`. Therefore the valid form is `<!-- This is a comment -->`.

qs.stem: To control the width of a cell, spanning two or more columns, which attribute is added to <th>, <td> tags?
qs.sol:
colspan specifies how many columns a table cell occupies.

width sets a width but does not make a cell span multiple columns.

qs.stem: Which of the following HTML code snippets is used to specify the path of a GIF image is stored at?
qs.sol:
The img element uses its src attribute to specify the image file path; here it points to example.gif.

The src attribute on IMG identifies the GIF path.

qs.stem: Which of the following statements about tag is NOT correct?

opts.A: The tag may contain the width attribute.
opts.B: The tag may contain the height attribute.
opts.C: The tag may contain both width and height attributes.
opts.D: The tag cannot contain either width attribute or height attribute.

qs.sol: The question asks for the incorrect statement about HTML tags. Width and height are valid attributes used for image sizing in standard markup. Therefore, the claim that these cannot be used is false and corresponds to option 3.

qs.stem:
What will be the output of the following segment of the HTML codes?
  1. coffee
  2. tea
  3. milk
qs.sol:
Key idea: The <ol> tag creates an ordered list, so the browser adds numbering automatically.

The given items are written in this order:
1. Coffee
2. Tea
3. Milk

Final answer: Option A

An HTML image map enables specific clickable areas within a single image to link to different URLs or locations. It utilizes the map and area tags to define interactive regions like rectangles or circles for user navigation, distinguishing it from standard image links.

qs.stem: What is tag in HTML?

opts.A: It contains the address of the webpage.
opts.B: It contains the number of nested tags in the page.
opts.C: It contains information about the webpage.
opts.D: It contains the number of tags in the web page.

qs.sol: An HTML tag defines an element that structures content and metadata on a webpage. Tags contain information about the page's components rather than storing addresses or counting other tags.

qs.stem:
The HTML code “

<ABBR title="Internet Explorer">IE</ABBR>

 abbreviation of Internet Explorer” is used to:
qs.sol:
The abbr element marks an abbreviation, while title supplies its expanded form.

abbr marks abbreviated text and title provides its expansion.

qs.stem: Which of the following HTML tags inside <select> element defines the available options in a list?
qs.sol: Within a select element, each option element defines an available choice.

qs.stem: With reference to legacy HTML <body> attributes, which attribute specifies the colour of a hyperlink after it has been visited?
qs.sol:
Key distinction:

VLINK: sets the colour of visited links in legacy HTML.

ALINK: sets the colour of an active link while it is being selected/clicked.

LINK: sets the colour of unvisited links.

Modern HTML note: these presentational body attributes are deprecated/obsolete; CSS such as :visited should be used instead.

Final answer: VLINK

Modified from the official paper: The printed phrase “after the mouse is clicked” is ambiguous between an active and a visited hyperlink; the bank clarifies the intended visited-link state.

The list-style shorthand covers these three individual sub-properties:

list-style-type: Defines the design of the marker (e.g., disc, circle, square, decimal, lower-roman).

list-style-position: Determines if the marker appears inside or outside the content flow (inside or outset).

list-style-image: Allows you to use a custom image as the marker (e.g., url('bullet.png')).

qs.stem: Which of the following usages is true with respect to frames in HTML?
qs.sol: The asterisk in the COLS value assigns the remaining frame width after the fixed 80-unit column. The printed tag misspells FRAMESET, but the paper marks this syntax.

qs.stem: Which of the following statement about HTML attributes is false?

opts.B: Attributes provide additional information about an element
opts.C: Attributes are always specified in the end tag
opts.D: Attributes usually come in name/value pairs like: name = "value"

qs.sol: HTML attributes provide additional information about elements and are always placed within the opening tag, not the end tag. Option 3 is incorrect because it claims attributes appear in the closing tag, making it the false statement.

qs.stem: Which of the following statements with reference to HTML is FALSE?

opts.A: HTML stands for Hyper Text Markup Language.
opts.B: HTML describes the meaning of a Web page.
opts.C: HTML consists of a series of elements.
opts.D: HTML elements tell the browser how to display the content.

qs.sol: HTML marks up the structure and content of a page. Saying it describes the page’s meaning is the false statement in the printed set.

qs.stem: Which of the following attributes of HTML element declares a namespace for tags used in HTML document?
qs.sol:
The xmlns attribute declares an XML namespace for elements in an HTML/XHTML document.

xmlns declares the namespace used by elements.

qs.stem: Which of the following is NOT an attribute that included by the HR tag which puts a horizontal line on the page?
qs.sol: For the old HTML `<hr>` tag, `SIZE`, `ALIGN`, and `WIDTH` are attributes. `SHADE` is not the standard attribute; the older attribute was `NOSHADE`.

qs.stem:
Which of the following statements about HTML styling and colour notation are true?

(i) The HTML style attribute is used to add styles to an element, such as colour, font, size, and more. (ii) HTML colours are specified with predefined colour names, or with RGB, HEX, HSL, RGBA, or HSLA values.
qs.sol:
Concept

HTML provides the document structure, while CSS controls presentation. The style attribute places CSS declarations directly on one HTML element, and CSS colour values can use named, hexadecimal, and functional notations.

Application

Statement (i) describes inline styling: declarations such as colour, font family, and font size may be supplied through the style attribute. Statement (ii) lists recognised colour-value forms: predefined names, HEX, RGB/RGBA, and HSL/HSLA.

Contrast

Accepting the inline-style description while excluding the colour-notation description conflicts with the supported colour-value forms. …

qs.stem: Which of the following tag of HTML language is a container for the tags that contain information about the page?
qs.sol: The `<head>` tag contains metadata and other tags that provide information about the web page.

qs.stem: In which of the following forms the EM element of emphasising text in HTML displays the emphasised text?
qs.sol:
The em element gives semantic emphasis and is normally rendered in italic type by browsers.

Italic is the default visual rendering of em.

qs.stem: Which of the following statements about HTML Attributes is FALSE?

opts.A: All HTML elements cannot have attributes.
opts.B: Attributes provide additional information about elements.
opts.C: Attributes are always specified in the start tag.
opts.D: Attributes usually come in name/value pairs like: name="value".

qs.sol: HTML attributes provide extra information about elements, and most elements support them. Option 1 incorrectly claims all HTML elements cannot have attributes. Since this statement is factually wrong, it is the correct choice for identifying the false statement.

qs.stem: Which attribute in HTML table tag defines the number of columns in a column group?
qs.sol: The attribute used to define the number of columns in a column group is span.This attribute is used within the <colgroup> or <col> tags to apply styles or structural rules to multiple columns simultaneously without repeating the code for every individual cell.

qs.stem: Which of the following metadata elements of HTML is used to specify a default URL and target for all the links in an HTML document?
qs.sol:
The base element sets the base URL and optional default target used by relative links in the document.

BASE defines the document’s base URL and default target.

qs.stem:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct regarding <title> tag in HTML?
 Statements:
 I. This tag always goes outside to the <head> tag.
 II. This tag is used to indicate the title of the webpage.
 III. It is also used by search engines.
qs.sol:
The <title> tag must be placed inside the <head> section, not outside.

It defines the title of the webpage displayed in browser tabs.

Additionally, search engines use this tag for indexing and displaying results.

qs.stem:
Which of the given options best describes the truthfulness of the following statements?
 i) Class is one of the HTML global attributes which specifies one or more class names for an element (refers to a class in a style sheet).
 ii) HTML is a markup language used for server-side processing.
 iii) CSS describes how HTML elements are to be displayed on screen, paper, or in other media.
qs.sol:
Concept: HTML is a markup language that describes document structure; a browser parses that structure, while server-side processing requires executable application logic. An HTML class is a global attribute whose tokens can be targeted by CSS selectors. CSS rules control presentation, including media-specific rendering.

For i, inspect the class attribute: it accepts one or more class tokens on an element, and selectors can use those tokens. Therefore i is true.

For ii, distinguish generating an HTML document on a server from executing logic in HTML itself. A server can produce HTML, but HTML is markup rather than a server-side processing language. Therefore ii is false. …

topics.title: 2. CSS — Styles, Selectors, Box Model, Properties
topics.theory:
- **Three ways to apply CSS:** **Inline** (`style` attribute), **Internal** (`<style>` in `<head>`), **External** (`<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="x.css">` — change one file to restyle the whole site). "Out-line style" is not a method. `link` attributes: rel, type, href (**not `ref`**).
- **Box model (inside → out):** **Content**, Padding, Border, Margin. `margin` shorthand sets all four sides in one declaration.
- **Properties:** `word-spacing` (space between words), `font-weight` (boldness), `font-variant` (small-caps), `font-style`, `font-family`, `font-size`, `text-decoration` values: underline, **overline**, line-through, none; `background-color` accepts colour name, hex, rgb()/rgba(), hsl().
- **Selectors:** type/element (`p`), class (`.x`), id (`#x`), universal (`*`), grouping (list). 
- **Responsive web design** = HTML + CSS that automatically resizes a site for all devices. **Bootstrap** = most popular CSS framework for responsive, mobile-first sites; Tailwind CSS = utility-first framework.
- **Colour:** hsl hue 0–360 (0 red, 120 green, 240 blue).

qs.stem: Which of the following is NOT a way to apply CSS to the HTML document?
qs.sol:
CSS can be applied with an internal style block, an external stylesheet, or inline declarations.

“Out-line style” is not one of these application methods.

qs.stem: Which of the following margin properties of Cascading Style Sheet allows specifying all margin properties in one declaration?
qs.sol:
The margin shorthand can assign the four side margins in one declaration.

Side-specific margin properties set only one side.

qs.stem: Which of the following Cascading Style Sheet text properties defines the minimum and maximum space between words?
qs.sol:
word-spacing adjusts the space between words.

white-space, word-break, and word-wrap govern whitespace handling or line breaks.

qs.stem: Which of the following is the most popular CSS framework for developing responsive and mobile-first websites?
qs.sol:
Bootstrap is a CSS framework for responsive, mobile-first websites.

Its grid and components support layouts across device sizes.

qs.stem: Which of the following is NOT a value accepted by background colour property of Cascading Style Sheet?
qs.sol:
CSS background colours can use colour names, hexadecimal notation, or RGB notation.

A binary equivalent of a colour is not a CSS colour value format.

qs.stem: Which of the following area of a box displays the content of a document in cascading style sheets?
qs.sol:
In the CSS box model, the content area contains and displays the element’s content.

Padding, border, and margin surround that area.

qs.stem: Which colour specification in CSS use three numbers representing the hue (from 0 to 360 degree), saturation percentage and lightness percentage?
qs.sol: CSS hsl() specifies hue angle, saturation percentage and lightness percentage in that order. These three components match the quantities in the stem.

qs.stem: Which of the following category of style sheet can be used to change the look of an entire website, by changing one file (CSS)?
qs.sol: External CSS is stored in a separate file linked to HTML pages. This allows centralized updates across the entire website without editing individual documents, unlike inline or internal CSS which require page-specific changes.

qs.stem: Which of the following is a text decoration property in Cascading Style Sheets?
qs.sol:
An overline is a text decoration drawn above text.

The remaining terms are not a text-decoration line value.

qs.stem: Which of the following category of CSS is defined in the <head> section of an HTML page, within a <style> element?
qs.sol:
Internal CSS is defined within a <style> element located in the head section of an HTML document.

Inline CSS applies styles directly to elements using the style attribute, while External CSS links to separate stylesheet files. Therefore, Internal CSS matches the description provided in the question.

qs.stem: Which property of CSS specifies the degree to which text should be emboldened?
qs.sol: The CSS property used to specify the degree of thickness or "boldness" of text is font-weight. This property accepts both keyword values and numeric values, allowing for precise control over how heavy the typeface appears.

qs.stem: Which of the following properties relating to a font is used display a font as normal or in small-caps in Cascading Style Sheets?
qs.sol:
The CSS font-variant property controls normal versus small-caps presentation.

The other properties control different aspects of a font.

qs.stem: In HTML, a color can be specified in the form of hsl(hue, saturation, lightness), where hue is a degree on the color wheel from 0 to 360. What are the hue values representing red, green, and blue?
qs.sol: In the HSL color model, hue is measured in degrees from 0 to 360 on a circular color wheel. Standard HTML specifications define red as 0 degrees, green as 120 degrees, and blue as 240 degrees. These values correspond to the primary positions on the color spectrum used for digital display.

qs.stem: Which of the following Cascading Style Sheet selectors matches all the elements specified in a list with the given value to determine the elements to which the CSS rules are to be applied?
qs.sol:
A type selector matches elements by their element name.

The stated matching criterion is a list of elements with a given name.

topics.title: 3. JavaScript, DOM & jQuery
topics.theory:
- **JavaScript:** client-side scripting; extension **`.js`**; embedded with **`<script>` … `</script>`** (head or body, **unlimited** scripts); accepts **single, double and backtick quotes**; can change HTML content, attributes and **CSS styles**, hide/show elements; defines **behaviour/interactivity** (events). Web scripting = creating and embedding scripts in pages.
- **String + number:** `"Volvo"+16+4` = **"Volvo164"** (left-to-right concatenation); `16+4+"Volvo"` = "20Volvo".
- **DOM:** objects with properties, methods, events; **window** = top-level browser object (master container); **document** = holds the page content; `location` = URL; `alert()` shows dialog. **Methods = actions** performed on objects; properties = values.
- **Callback function** = function passed into another function as argument. **`instanceof`** → true if object is an instance of a type. **`for…in`** iterates object property keys. `event.preventDefault()` stops default action (e.g., form submit). `Object.defineProperty` with writable:false blocks assignment.
- **Events:** onchange, onmouseover, onkeydown, onload (page finished loading), onclick, onsubmit — events give a **dynamic** interface.
- **jQuery:** `hide()` and `show()` methods; `$("p").hide()`. DHTML = **Dynamic** HTML (HTML + CSS + JavaScript + DOM), not a language.

qs.stem: JavaScript files have the file extension __________.
qs.sol: JavaScript files universally utilize the .js file extension for standard web development environments. This convention is recognized by all major browsers and servers as the primary format.

qs.stem: The process of creating and embedding scripts in a web page is known as ______.
qs.sol: Creating scripts and placing them in a web page is web scripting. Scripts add behaviour to the page.

qs.stem: Which HTML tag is used to embed Java Script scripts in a page?
qs.sol: To embed JavaScript in an HTML page, we use the <script> tag.

qs.stem: With jQuery, we can hide and show HTML elements with the ______ and ______ methods.
qs.sol:
jQuery provides hide() and show() methods for controlling element visibility.

Calling these methods hides or displays the selected HTML elements.

qs.stem:
What is/are the purpose(s) of JavaScript events?
 i) Provide a dynamic interface to a webpage.
 ii) Provide a static interface to a webpage.
qs.sol: JavaScript events enable webpages to respond dynamically to user interactions and browser actions. This functionality supports statement (i) by creating a dynamic interface, whereas static interfaces do not rely on event handling.

qs.stem:
What will be the result of the following JavaScript:

var x="Volvo"+16+4
qs.sol:
The first addition joins the string and 16; the next joins 4, yielding Volvo164.

String concatenation preserves the capital V and does not add 16 and 4 arithmetically.

qs.stem: Which object holds the real content of the page in JavaScript?
qs.sol: In JavaScript, the document object represents the web page and holds the page's actual content as the DOM. The window object represents the browser window, location stores URL information, and alert displays a message dialog. Hence the correct answer is Document.

qs.stem: Which of the following JS browser objects represents browser’s window?
qs.sol:
The Window object represents the browser window and is the global browser object.

Location represents the current URL.

qs.stem: Which of the following statements about JavaScript is true?

opts.A: JavaScript accepts both double and single quotes.
opts.D: JavaScript accepts neither double nor single quotes.

qs.sol: JavaScript string literals support single quotes ('), double quotes ("), and backticks (`). Option 0 correctly identifies that both single and double quotes are valid syntax for defining strings in JavaScript code.
JavaScript is used to define the behavior and interactivity of web pages.

qs.stem: The ‘instanceof’ JS operator returns ______.

opts.C: True if an object is an instance of an object type
opts.D: True if an object is a method of an object type

qs.sol:
instanceof tests whether the constructor’s prototype occurs in the object’s prototype chain.

Methods are callable properties; instanceof does not test whether an object is a method.

qs.stem: Any time you include JavaScript verbiage in HTML document, you must enclose those lines inside a ____ tag pair.
qs.sol: To include JavaScript code within an HTML document, you must wrap the script lines inside <script> and </script> tags. This tells the browser to interpret the enclosed content as executable JavaScript rather than static HTML.

qs.stem: In java script a __________ function can be defined as a function passed into another function as a parameter.
qs.sol: In JavaScript, a callback function is defined as a function passed into another function as an argument. This pattern enables asynchronous operations and allows the inner function to execute after the outer function completes.

qs.stem: In JavaScript, the _____ is the master container for all content you view in the web browser.
qs.sol: The Window Object is the master container in JavaScript's browser environment. It represents the top-level object containing all other objects like document, location, and screen within the browser window hierarchy.

qs.stem: Which window method generates a dialog box that displays whatever text you pass as a parameter in JavaScript?
qs.sol: The alert method displays a dialog box with a specified message and an OK button. Options like display, show, or perform are not valid JavaScript window methods for generating standard dialog boxes. Therefore, alert is the correct function to use when passing text as a parameter for user notification.

qs.stem: Which of the following are actions that can be performed on objects in JavaScript?
qs.sol:
Methods are callable actions associated with objects.

A function definition describes code; it is not the name for object actions.

qs.stem: In Document Object Model (DOM), all the properties, methods and events that are available to a web developer for manipulating and creating web pages are organised into:
qs.sol:
The DOM represents page content as a hierarchy of objects. Their properties, methods and events provide the programming interface.

DOM APIs are organized around objects such as nodes and documents.

A submit event reaches its handler with a default browser action. Calling event.preventDefault() marks that default action as canceled, so the form is not submitted by the browser. Event propagation and explicit submission are separate mechanisms.

qs.stem: Which of the following statements about JavaScript is FALSE?

opts.B: JavaScript can change HTML attribute values.

qs.sol: JavaScript can dynamically modify HTML element styles using the DOM API. Since Option 0 claims JavaScript cannot change styles, this statement is false and correctly answers the question.

qs.stem: Which of the following is NOT a part of the document object model (DOM) with respect to the type of object?
qs.sol:
The traditional DOM specifications distinguish Core, HTML and XML interfaces. Class is not one of those object-type divisions.

Class is not a DOM object-type division.

The `for...in` statement enumerates an object’s enumerable property keys directly. For each key, the body can access the associated value through bracket notation, so it is the method described by the question.

qs.stem:
Which of the following statements related to business computing is/are true?

(i) You can place only five scripts in an HTML document. 
(ii) JavaScripts can be placed in the <body>, or in the <head> section of an HTML page, or in both.
qs.sol: Statement (i) is incorrect because HTML documents do not limit the number of script tags to five. Statement (ii) is correct as JavaScript can be embedded in either the head, body, or both sections of an HTML page. Therefore, only statement (ii) is true.

Object.defineProperty stores age as 
25
25 and sets writable to false.

The later assignment to 
30
30 has no effect in this non-strict code, so console.log reads and outputs 
25
25.

qs.stem:
Match the column  JavaScript-Events  with the column  Descriptions .
 JavaScript-Events:
 a) onchange
 b) onmouseover
 c) onkeydown
 d) onload
 Descriptions:
 i) The browser has finished loading the page.
 ii) An HTML element has been changed.
 iii) The user moves the mouse over an HTML element.
 iv) The user pushes a keyboard key.
qs.sol: The correct matches are: onchange with element changes (a-ii), onmouseover with mouse hover (b-iii), onkeydown with key presses (c-iv), and onload with page finishing load (d-i). These pairings align with standard JavaScript event definitions.

topics.title: 4. XML
topics.theory:
- **XML** = eXtensible Markup Language; user-defined tags; used to represent and **exchange structured data between systems**; case-sensitive.
- **Rules:** every element needs a closing tag, **proper nesting**, attribute values **quoted**, **tag names are case-sensitive** (`<Markup></markup>` is invalid), one root element; names **cannot start with a digit or the letters "xml"** and cannot contain spaces. Comments `<!-- … -->` (single or multi-line). **Declaration:** `<?xml version="1.0" standalone="yes"?>`. Empty element: `<tag />`. Escape `<` as **`<`**, `>` as `>`, `&` as `&`.
- **DTD vs XML Schema:** DTD (from SGML) has **no data types**; **XML Schema defines datatypes** for elements/attributes and is written in XML. DTD `<!ELEMENT note (message)>` → child "message" occurs **exactly once** (`+` one or more, `*` zero or more, `?` optional).

qs.sol: XML represents content with nested element tags, optional attributes on elements, and permitted comments. These are syntactic components of an XML document.

XML represents structured data with user-defined tags. A sender can serialize fields into an XML document, and a receiving system can parse those tags without sharing the same programming language or platform. This makes representation and exchange between systems the practical use described.

qs.stem: Which of the following is a valid XML declaration?
qs.sol:
An XML declaration begins with <?xml, gives a quoted version value, and ends with ?>.

Only the marked declaration has that complete form.

qs.stem: Which of the following commands is used to comment out multiple lines in an XML file?

opts.A:
<!-- This is a

multi-line

XML comment -->
opts.B:
/*

This XML file

contains a list

of custom information

*/
opts.D:
<--

This XML file

contains a list

of custom information

-->

qs.sol: XML documents require specific delimiters to mark sections as comments. Enclose your text block between <!-- and --> to span multiple lines correctly. Syntax from other programming languages like Java or C is invalid within XML files.

qs.stem:
Consider the following XML statement:

<Markup>xml statement</markup>

This statement is invalid due to:
qs.sol:
XML tag names are case-sensitive.

<Markup> and </markup> differ in capitalisation, so the closing tag does not match the opening tag.

qs.stem: Which of the following rules is FALSE with respect to XML structure?

opts.A: All XML elements must have proper nesting
opts.D: All XML elements must have a closing tag

qs.sol:
XML names are case-sensitive, so tags differing only in case do not match.

Proper nesting and quoted attribute values are XML requirements.

qs.stem: The trailing “/>” in the syntax indicates to a program processing XML statement that the element is:
qs.sol:
The /> ending is the self-closing syntax for an empty XML element.

It combines the opening and closing of that element.

qs.stem: Which of the following notations can be used to encode string <element> in XML document?
qs.sol: The official key selects <element&gt because it puts the lt and gt entity names in the intended order. As printed, it omits the required semicolons; valid XML character references would be <element>. Thus the keyed printed notation expresses the intended answer but is not itself valid XML syntax.

qs.stem: Which of the following rule is needed to be followed while declaring the XML (Extensible Markup Language) elements name?

opts.A: Name must start with a number
opts.C: Name must not start with the letters XML
opts.D: Name cannot contain letter, numbers and other characters

qs.sol: An XML element name must not start with the letters XML in any case combination. XML names also cannot start with a digit and cannot contain spaces. Therefore the valid rule among the options is that the name must not start with XML.

qs.stem: The XML statement <!ELEMENT note(message)> declares ________.

opts.A: The child element “message” must occur only once inside the “note” element
opts.B: The child element “message” must occur one or more times inside the “note” element
opts.C: The “note” element can contain zero or more occurrences of parsed character data
opts.D: The “note” element can contain only one occurrence of parsed character data

qs.sol:
In a DTD child-element declaration, an unqualified child name means exactly one occurrence.

Quantifiers such as + or * would change that cardinality.

qs.stem:
Which of the given options best describes the truthfulness of the following statements?
 i) XML schemas define datatypes for elements and attributes, while DTD doesn't support datatypes.
 ii) DTD are the declarations that define a document type for SGML.
 iii) In XML, tag names can begin with a numeric value.
qs.sol: Statement i is true because XML Schema supports rich datatypes unlike DTD which lacks them. Statement ii is true as DTDs were originally designed for SGML document types. Statement iii is false because XML tag names cannot start with numbers according to W3C specifications. Therefore, Option 0 is the correct choice based on standard XML and SGML definitions.

topics.title: 5. Server-side: ASP, ASP.NET, VBScript, ADO, PHP
topics.theory:
- **ASP = Active Server Pages** (Microsoft, server-side, language-independent technology; default VBScript; file `.asp`). Successor of classic ASP = **ASP.NET**. Models: Classic ASP, ASP.NET Web Forms, **ASP.NET MVC**, ASP.NET Core.
- **ASP objects:** **Response** (send output to user), Request (read client input), Session, Application (methods **Lock/Unlock**), Server. Server variable **HTTP_USER_AGENT** = browser description. **AdRotator** component shows a different image on each refresh.
- **VBScript:** single data type **Variant**; declare with **`Dim`**; assignment `strName = "John Smith"`; **`CSng`** converts to Single; **`Timer`** = seconds since 12:00 AM; **Sub procedure does not return a value (Function does)**; constants Empty, Nothing, Null.
- **ADO = ActiveX Data Objects**; **Connection object opens a connection to a data source**; Recordset holds records.
- **.NET:** **CLR (Common Language Runtime)** = virtual machine that manages execution (includes the JIT compiler); **WPF = Windows Presentation Foundation**; **data binding** connects data source to controls; **AJAX = Asynchronous JavaScript And XML** (update parts of a page without reload).
- **PHP:** open-source server-side scripting; uses **SQL commands** inside the script to store HTML form data in a database; MySQL back end.

qs.stem: Which ASP development model is successor to classic ASP?
qs.sol:
Concept: A server-side web framework processes browser requests on the server and generates responses such as HTML. A platform supplies the runtime and services; a development model specifies how an application organizes pages, events, or request handling.

To identify a successor, distinguish the historical replacement of a technology from particular programming models and later generations within its family.

Classic ASP executes server-side scripts embedded in pages. For example, a request for a page can execute VBScript, retrieve data, and return generated HTML.

Microsoft introduced ASP.NET as the succeeding web framework built on the .NET runtime. …

qs.stem: Which of the following is a valid assignment in ASP?
qs.sol: The print uses typographic quotes as stand-ins for code quotes. The intended executable VBScript form is strName="John Smith", with an assignable variable on the left.

qs.stem: What is AJAX in ASP.NET?
qs.sol: AJAX is the abbreviation of Asynchronous JavaScript and XML. It allows a web page to communicate with the server asynchronously, so only the required part of the page can be updated instead of reloading the entire page. Therefore, the expansion is Asynchronous JavaScript and XML.

qs.stem: Which of the following ASP objects is used to send information to the user?
qs.sol:
Response sends output from the ASP server to the user.

Request reads information sent by the client.

qs.stem: What is the full form of ASP with reference to ASP.NET?
qs.sol: ASP expands to Active Server Pages, Microsoft’s server-side web technology name. ASP.NET follows that naming.

qs.stem: What is the name of the virtual machine component of Microsoft .NET Framework which manages the execution of .NET programs?
qs.sol:
The Common Language Runtime (CLR) is the managed execution engine of the .NET Framework — essentially a virtual machine that loads compiled Intermediate Language (IL) code, verifies type safety, applies Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation to native machine code, and manages memory (garbage collection), exception handling, and security while a program runs.

The question asks specifically which .NET Framework virtual-machine component manages the execution of .NET programs — that is exactly the CLR's role: it hosts and executes the managed code within a running .NET program, from loading through to completion. …

qs.stem: Which of the following ASP VB functions converts an expression to a variant of subtype single?
qs.sol:
Concept: A VBScript variable stores a Variant, whose subtype identifies how its current value is represented.

Explicit conversion functions select a numeric subtype. Single and Double use floating-point representations; Integer and Long use integral representations.

Application: In classic ASP, VBScript code runs on the server. The requested conversion must produce a Variant with the Single subtype.

Start with a numeric value such as 12.5, which has a fractional part.

Apply CSng(12.5): the value remains 12.5 and the result has subtype Single.

Inspect the result with TypeName(CSng(12.5)); it reports Single. Thus both the converted value and its subtype can be checked. …

qs.stem: Which of the following keywords is used to explicitly declare variables in ASP?
qs.sol:
VBScript in ASP uses Dim to declare a variable.

Option Explicit requires declarations but is not itself the variable declaration keyword.

qs.stem: Which of the following is NOT a development model supported by ASP?
qs.sol:
The printed ASP.NET APT label does not name an ASP development model.

The other labels identify ASP or ASP.NET variants.

qs.stem: Which of the following is NOT a built-in constant in ASP?
qs.sol:
Empty, Nothing, and NULL are recognised VBScript values or keywords used in ASP.

FULL is not a built-in constant.

qs.stem: Which of the following is the expansion of ADO with respect to ASP?
qs.sol:
ADO expands to ActiveX Data Objects, the database access interface used with ASP.

ADO does not expand Alternative.

qs.stem: Which of the following should be placed inside PHP script to store information in the database through HTML form?
qs.sol: A PHP script uses SQL commands to insert form data into a database. The form supplies the data; the database operation is expressed as a query.

qs.stem: Which of the following functions of ASP is used to get the number of seconds since 12:00 AM?
qs.sol:
Timer returns the number of seconds elapsed since midnight.

Time returns a time value, while TimeValue and TimeSerial create or convert time values.

qs.stem: Which of the following data-types is supported by VBScript, which is often used to create ASP that can store different types of data?
qs.sol:
VBScript variables have the Variant data type, which can hold values of different subtypes.

The other terms describe values or subtypes, not its general variable type.

qs.stem: The ADO connection object is used to:

opts.A: Hold a set of records from a database table
opts.B: Create an open connection to a data source
opts.D: Display only selected set of records and fields to view

qs.sol:
The ADO Connection opens a link to a data source.

Displaying Recordset data is separate from establishing a connection.

qs.stem: The term ____ in ASP.NET means that data that is collected from a source is bound to the controls that provide the read and write connection to the data.
qs.sol:
In ASP.NET, Data binding refers to the process of connecting data from a data source to controls such as GridView, ListBox, or TextBox. These controls can then read, display, and sometimes update the data.

Data binding simplifies the interaction between the user interface and the data source.

qs.stem: Which of the following ASP server variables returns a string that describes the browser that sent the request?
qs.sol:
HTTP_USER_AGENT carries the browser user-agent description from the request.

SERVER_NAME names the host serving the request.

qs.stem: Which of the following is a method of ASP application object?
qs.sol:
Application.Lock is a method that prevents other sessions from changing application-wide variables during an update.

The other names belong to other members or objects.

qs.stem: Which of the following is FALSE with respect to VBScript sub procedures in ASP?

opts.A: Sub procedure is a series of statements
opts.B: Sub procedure is enclosed by Sub and End Sub statements
opts.C: Sub procedure will perform actions and return a value

qs.sol:
A VBScript Sub executes statements but does not return a value.

A Function procedure can return a value.

qs.stem:
Which of the given options best describes the truthfulness of the following statements?
 i) Just-In-Time compiler (JIT) is a part of Common Language Runtime (CLR).
 ii) .NET Framework is part of the .NET platform, a collection of technologies for building apps for Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android.
 iii) ASP.NET applications are compiled codes, written using the extensible and reusable components or objects present in .NET framework.
qs.sol:
Statement (i) is true because the Just-In-Time compiler is a core component of the Common Language Runtime.

Statement (ii) is true as the .NET Framework supports cross-platform development within the broader .NET ecosystem. Statement (iii) is also true since ASP.NET applications utilize reusable components and compile to Intermediate Language code.

qs.stem: Which of the following ASP component creates an object that displays a different image each time a user enters or refreshes a page?
qs.sol:
AdRotator selects and displays an advertisement image when the page is served.

Counter counts events; it does not select an image.

qs.stem: What does WPF stand for in the Microsoft .NET ecosystem?
qs.sol:
An acronym-expansion question is answered by matching the acronym to its officially documented name, not by picking a plausible-sounding phrase. Microsoft's .NET platform is made up of several named subsystems -- for example ASP.NET for web applications, WinForms for legacy desktop UI, and WPF for modern desktop UI -- each with a specific, vendor-documented full name.

WPF was introduced by Microsoft with .NET Framework 3.0 in 2006 as the subsystem for building rich Windows desktop applications using XAML markup, vector graphics, data binding, styles, and templates. Microsoft's own documentation (Microsoft Learn / .NET docs) records its full name as Windows Presentation Foundation. …

qs.stem: Which of the following is true with respect to ASP?

opts.A: Most of the functionality that can be built into ASP pages comes from objects on the client
opts.C: ASP enables client side scripting for IIS
opts.D: Files created with ASP have the extension .aspn

qs.sol:
Classic ASP can use more than one scripting language, so its technology is language-independent.

It executes server-side and normally uses the .asp extension.

topics.title: 6. E-commerce & E-business
topics.theory:
- **EDI** = Electronic Data Interchange; **EFT** = Electronic Fund Transfer; **EPS** types: smart cards, e-wallet, EFT, credit/debit cards. **M-commerce:** mobile security is a major impediment; reduces transaction cost; mobile payments/coupons.
- **Advantages of e-commerce:** reduced paperwork and cost, 24×7 availability, wider reach; **user resistance is a challenge, not an advantage.** Key drivers of e-business: commercial benefits, customers'/suppliers' requirements, skilled and committed workforce (not "supplementary workforce").
- **Online trading steps:** open Demat + trading account → allocate funds → place order → system forwards to exchange. **Barriers** external to organisation (micro-environment): business models etc. **Visibility strategies:** guessable sensible domain name, upload special offers/content regularly.

qs.stem: With respect to e-commerce, what is the full form of EFT?
qs.sol: EFT stands for Electronic Fund Transfer. It means transferring money electronically from one account or system to another.

qs.stem: With respect to e-commerce, what is the full form of EDI?
qs.sol: EDI stands for Electronic Data Interchange. It is the computer-to-computer exchange of business documents in a standard electronic format.

qs.stem:
Which of the following are the types of Electronic Payment Systems (EPS)?
 I.  Smart Cards
 II.  E-Wallet
 III.  Electronic Funds Transfer
qs.sol: Smart cards, e-wallets and Electronic Funds Transfer are all examples of electronic payment systems.

qs.stem: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of e-commerce?
qs.sol: Reduced paperwork, lower cost and 24x7 availability are advantages of e-commerce. User resistance is a challenge, not an advantage.

qs.stem: Procedure for online trading involve(s) which of the following step(s)? I. Make an application to open a Demat Account and Online Trading Account. II. Allocate funds from the bank account to the trading account. III. Once the order is confirmed, it is placed in the stock exchange through the online trading system.
qs.sol: Online trading starts by opening Demat and trading accounts, then allocating funds. After an order is confirmed, the online system forwards it to the exchange. All three stated steps belong to the procedure.

qs.stem: Which of the following is NOT a key driver of e-business?
qs.sol: A “key driver” of e-business is an internal, organisational-level force that pushes a firm to adopt and invest in electronic ways of doing business. Standard e-business frameworks group these drivers into a small, well-defined set: commercial benefit (cost and efficiency gains), a workforce that is skilled and committed to using the new technology, and the changing requirements of customers and suppliers who increasingly expect to transact online. …

qs.stem:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct regarding m-commerce?
 I. Mobile security is one of the prominent impediments of m-commerce.
 II. M-commerce reduces overall transaction cost through streamlined business processes.
 III. Mobile coupons and mobile ticket delivery are m-commerce services.
qs.sol: Mobile security, reduced transaction cost, and mobile coupons/payments are all associated with m-commerce.

qs.stem:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct regarding the strategies required to increase the visibility of e-commerce website?

I. The website name should be sensible that it can be guessed.

II. Uploading contents like special offers or eye catching information for the regular followers can increase traffic on the website.

III. Icons of social networks on the website have no major influence on e-visibility.
qs.sol: Statement I is correct because a meaningful and easy-to-guess website name improves recall and helps users find the site again. Statement II is also correct because regularly uploading special offers, useful information, or eye-catching content can increase repeat visits and website traffic. Statement III is incorrect because social-network icons or links can help users share the website and can bring traffic from social platforms. Therefore, only statements I and II are correct.

qs.stem: Which of the following is a barrier to e-commerce related to micro-environmental issues external to the organisation?
qs.sol:
E-commerce barriers are grouped by where they arise relative to the organisation: internal barriers come from within the organisation's own resources and processes; external micro-environmental barriers come from the immediate market and industry context around the organisation, such as the practices of trading partners and competitors; external macro-environmental barriers come from the broader societal, technological, and cultural forces shaping the whole industry.

Among the options here, business models are the one rooted in the external market and industry context surrounding the organisation, which is exactly what defines a micro-environmental barrier. …

topics.title: 7. Internet, Browsers, Web Concepts & Web Design
topics.theory:
- **WWW:** system of linked documents/resources accessed over the Internet using a browser; **website = collection of web pages**; webserver hosts them. **Web browser = client**; webmaster runs the web servers.
- **URI** names/identifies a resource; **URL** gives its location (a URL is a type of URI). **ARPA(NET)** funded 1960s research connecting computers. **BOOTP** = protocol for booting computers from the network (basis of DHCP). **Chrome DevTools: Ctrl+Shift+I** (Windows) — inspect/debug pages. **Geolocation** lets users share location with trusted sites.
- **Instant messaging:** Snapchat, WeChat, Signal (Firefox is a browser). Privacy concern: data security. Google Meet = video conferencing. Netiquette: proper grammar/punctuation, respectful posts.
- **Web design:** **wireframe** = rough skeletal outline (which content on which page, navigation between pages); tools: Webflow etc. User-friendly site: fast, accessible, browser-consistent, **not cluttered**. Static site: same content each load, no server-side processing, fast; dynamic: content changes.
- **Client-server:** client handles presentation, processing logic; shared resources are controlled by the server. Applet = Java program embedded in HTML. Front-end: HTML5 (markup), JS libraries (React), frameworks (Tailwind/Bootstrap), assets (Font Awesome), reset CSS (boilerplate).
- **Sequence structure:** statements execute in written order, once each, none repeated.

qs.stem: Which of the following features is provided by Google Meet?
qs.sol: Google Meet connects participants in real-time audio and video meetings. Video conferencing is its core function.

qs.stem: A collection of web pages is known as _____.
qs.sol: A collection of related web pages is called a website.

qs.stem: In DHTML, the letter 'D' stands for:
qs.sol: DHTML stands for Dynamic HTML. It is not a single language but a combination of technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that allows web pages to change dynamically without reloading.

qs.stem: What is the primary function of the World Wide Web (WWW)?

opts.A: To connect and access documents and resources over the internet

qs.sol: The World Wide Web links documents and other resources through network protocols. A browser requests a resource using its address, and the server returns the associated content. This lets users connect to and access documents and resources across the internet.

qs.stem: Which of the following is NOT an instant messaging service?
qs.sol: Firefox is a web browser. Snapchat, WeChat, and Signal support direct person-to-person messaging, so Firefox is the item outside that service category.

qs.stem: Which of the following is an application of the World Wide Web?

opts.B: Sending emails directly to a mobile phone
opts.C: Browsing websites and accessing online services

qs.sol: The World Wide Web is a system of linked resources accessed over web protocols. A browser lets users visit sites and use online services built on it.

qs.stem: Which of the following is a privacy concern with Instant Messaging (IM) applications?
qs.sol:
IM services transmit personal conversations and files, so unauthorized access or weak protection can expose private data.

Data security directly addresses confidentiality and protection of those communications.

qs.stem: Shortcut key used to open Google chrome developer tools in windows is ______.
qs.sol: In Chrome on Windows, the keyboard shortcut for opening Developer Tools is Ctrl+Shift+I. The extra Shift modifier distinguishes it from ordinary browser commands.

qs.stem: Which of the following agency started showing interest, in 1960s, in finding a way to connect computers so that researchers could share their ideas?
qs.sol:
ARPA sponsored the early research that connected computers and enabled researchers to share information. This work led to ARPANET.

ARPA funded the early computer networking effort.

qs.stem: Using HTML and CSS to automatically resize a website and making a website look good on all devices (desktops, tablets, and phones) is referred to as
qs.sol:
Responsive web design adapts a page layout to different screen sizes.

HTML and CSS can make it display well on desktops, tablets, and phones.

qs.stem: _____ lets users show their location with websites they trust.
qs.sol:
Modern web browsers expose a permission-gated location mechanism: it determines a device's approximate physical position — via GPS, Wi-Fi access points, cell towers, or IP address — and hands those coordinates to a requesting website, but only after the user explicitly grants consent. This is what lets a user choose to reveal their location to sites they trust while keeping it hidden from everyone else.

This exact permission-based location-sharing mechanism is what browsers standardize as Geolocation (the Geolocation API), so the blank is filled by Geolocation. …

qs.stem: ______ protocol is used for starting computers from the network.
qs.sol: Modified from the official paper: The official paper cancelled the item. BOOTP supplies boot-time network configuration to a diskless client.

qs.stem: What is the purpose of a web browser's developer tools?

opts.A: To inspect and debug web pages
opts.C: To host web pages on the web server

qs.sol:
Developer tools provide inspectors, consoles, debuggers, and network panels.

These functions let a developer inspect and debug a web page while it is loaded in the browser.

qs.stem: A web browser is an example of ____.
qs.sol: A web browser acts as a client in the client-server model because it requests resources from web servers.

qs.stem: _____ is the person who runs our web servers.
qs.sol:
In IT and web operations, job roles are distinguished by which part of the technology stack a person is responsible for — collecting and interpreting data, modeling databases, designing visual interfaces, or administering and maintaining the servers that host and serve live websites.

The person who configures, operates, and maintains a web server — publishing content, managing server settings, monitoring uptime, and keeping the hosted website running — is known as a webmaster. That is exactly the responsibility described here: the person who runs the web servers. …

qs.stem: From which of the following language is HTML derived?
qs.sol:
HTML was originally defined as an application of SGML, a standard for describing markup languages.

SGML is the markup-language standard from which early HTML was derived.

qs.stem: Which of the following is a tool for site mapping and wireframing in web design?
qs.sol:
Webflow is a web design platform for arranging and prototyping website structure.

Its visual design tools can support site mapping and wireframing.

qs.stem: Which of the following markup standards is commonly used for the front end of a MySQL-backed web application?
qs.sol: Modified from the official paper: the printed question asks for a frequently used front-end technology, which also admits JavaScript; the stem now specifies a markup standard. HTML 5 defines the markup structure of web pages, while JavaScript supplies behavior.

qs.stem: Which of the following is NOT a type of INPUT element of form in HTML?
qs.sol:
HTML input supports checkbox, radio and submit types. Source is not an input type.

source is not a valid type value for input.

qs.stem: A Java program that is embedded in an HTML document and runs in the context of a Java-capable browser is known as ______.
qs.sol: A Java program embedded in an HTML document and running within a browser context is called a Java Applet. These applications were designed to run client-side but are now largely deprecated in modern web standards.

qs.stem: Which of the following refers to a set of characters used to identify or name a resource on the internet?
qs.sol:
A Uniform Resource Identifier is a character string that identifies a resource on the internet.

URI identifies or names a resource.

qs.stem: Which of the following is a standard for specifying any kind of information on the internet?
qs.sol:
A URL gives a standardized address for locating an Internet resource. The other terms concern state, page markup, or server interfaces.

A URL specifies the location of an Internet resource.

qs.stem: Which of the following is incorrect regarding user-friendly website?

opts.A: It should have faster loading time

qs.sol: A user-friendly website should load quickly, be accessible and behave consistently across browsers. It should not be cluttered.

qs.stem:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are true about wire framing of website?
 I. Showing which content will appear on which page
 II. Showing navigator between pages
qs.sol:
A wireframe is the skeletal blueprint stage of UX/UI design: before any colour, typography, or imagery is decided, a wireframe deliberately strips a page down to structure — it defines WHAT content sits WHERE on a page, and HOW a user moves BETWEEN pages (the site's navigation / information architecture).

Applying this to the two statements: Statement I describes exactly the content-placement role of a wireframe — showing which content block appears on which page. Statement II describes the navigation role — showing the links/paths connecting one page to another. A standard wireframe deliverable covers both of these at the same time, so both statements hold. …

qs.stem: ______ produces a rough outline of what the website will look like when it is done.
qs.sol: Before visual styling and development, a designer sketches the positions of page elements and content regions. That structural outline is a wireframe. It shows the eventual page layout without requiring final colors, images, or code.

qs.stem: Identify the incorrect statement.

opts.B: JavaScript is the scripting standard for HTML
opts.C: DHTML is the art of combining HTML, JavaScript, DOM, and CSS
opts.D: DHTML is a term used to describe the technologies used to make web pages dynamic and interactive

qs.sol: The question asks to identify the incorrect statement regarding web technologies. Option A incorrectly defines DHTML as a programming language, whereas it is actually a combination of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Options B, C, and D accurately describe the roles of these technologies.

qs.stem: Which of the following is false with reference to static website?

opts.A: Same content is loaded everytime the page is loaded
opts.B: It is loaded at a faster speed

qs.sol: Static websites serve fixed HTML files without server-side processing. Content remains consistent across visits and does not change dynamically at runtime, making the claim about runtime changes false.

qs.stem: In client-server computing, which of the following is NOT handled by a client?
qs.sol:
A client handles its user-facing presentation and can perform local processing or storage tasks. Control of shared resources belongs to the server side of the architecture.

Shared resources are provided and controlled by the server.

qs.stem: Which of the following actions demonstrates good netiquette in an online forum?

opts.D: Responding to others' posts with insults

qs.sol: Clear, respectful writing helps others understand a forum post. Proper grammar and punctuation are a practical part of good online etiquette.

qs.stem: Which of the following is NOT an attribute of HTML LINK element used to link CSS with web pages?
qs.sol:
The link element uses href for the resource address and rel for its relationship; type can identify the media type.

“ref” is not the linking attribute shown in the question.

qs.stem: Which statements are true about sequence structure during program execution? I. Each statement is executed once II. No statement is repeated III. The statements are executed in any order
qs.sol: Sequence control runs statements in their written order, ordinarily once each. It neither repeats a statement nor permits arbitrary execution order. Statements I and II hold; III fails.

qs.stem:
Match List-I with List-II.
List-I
a) Front-end framework
b) Front-end asset
c) Front-end boilerplate
d) JavaScript library

List-II
i) React JS
ii) Tailwind CSS
iii) Font Awesome
iv) Reset CSS
qs.sol: Tailwind CSS is the front-end CSS framework; Font Awesome supplies front-end icons and other visual assets; Reset CSS is the front-end reset or boilerplate stylesheet; React JS is the JavaScript library. These roles give the matching Tailwind CSS → front-end framework, Font Awesome → front-end asset, Reset CSS → front-end boilerplate, and React JS → JavaScript library.
